body: **Foco:** Comunicação integrada: Problemas sociais.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (problemas sociais).
**Texto do dia:** resenha / review.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo integrar leitura, escuta, fala e escrita numa resenha sobre um relatório social, com várias estruturas da unidade.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Review: “Out of Sight”, a Report on Hidden Homelessness
paras: The report **is said to be** the most thorough study of its kind. **It is estimated that** four in ten homeless people never appear in official counts. **Having been collected** over three years, the data is rich; **the more** one reads, **the more** troubling it becomes.

The authors **associate** hidden homelessness **with** overcrowding and precarious work. Their recommendations are sensible, though **the extent to which** they are affordable is unclear. A bolder chapter on funding would have helped.

items.q: Four in ten homeless people appear in official counts, it is estimated.
The data was collected over three years.
The reviewer finds the funding chapter bold.
items.why: a bolder chapter … would have helped.

blocks.body: Numa resenha crítica: **resumo + ponto forte + fraqueza + veredito**, com estruturas variadas.

items.s: The report is ___ to be thorough. (say)
___ been collected over three years, the data is rich. (Having)
The more one reads, the ___ troubling it is. (more)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Out of sight, out of mind.** — Longe dos olhos, longe do coração.
**Tip of the iceberg** — Ponta do iceberg
**Paint a bleak picture** — Pintar um quadro sombrio
**Shed light on…** — Lançar luz sobre…
**Scratch the surface** — Arranhar a superfície
**Hit the nail on the head.** — Acertar em cheio.
**Leave a lot to be desired** — Deixar a desejar
**Strike the right note** — Acertar o tom
**Did you finish the report?** — Você terminou o relatório?
**What is its weakness?** — Qual é sua fraqueza?
**Yes. It is said to be thorough, and I agree.** — Sim. Diz-se que é minucioso, e concordo.

blocks.title: Book club
lines: Yes. It is said to be thorough, and I agree.
Sim. Diz-se que é minucioso, e concordo.
It does not explain how to fund its ideas.
Não explica como financiar suas ideias.

items.note: Pausas e ritmo: faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido; o ritmo do inglês se apoia nas sílabas fortes, e as fracas se encolhem.
words: In my view, | the evidence | is mixed.
Having read the report, | she agreed.
On the one hand, | it works.

prompts.q: Give a verdict on a report.
prompts.model: It is thorough, but the funding chapter is weak.
It is estimated that many people are uncounted.
The more I read, the more concerned I am.

blocks.task: Write a 7-sentence critical review of a report, article or film on a social issue.
blocks.model: The documentary is said to be the most honest portrait of rural poverty. It is estimated that one child in five lives in these conditions. Having been filmed over two years, it feels intimate. The more one watches, the more moving it becomes. The authors associate poverty with poor transport. Its weakness is the lack of solutions. Overall, a thoughtful film worth seeing.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
